sentences.text: Zoneait is an extinct genus of marine crocodile relative known only from the species Zoneait nargorum.
This animal possessed a streamlined skull with expanded prefrontals that supported eyes facing to the sides.
The skull shows evidence of salt glands with elongated passages for the carotid artery, which may have increased blood flow to the glands.
Eric Wilberg named the species in 2015 based on partial skulls, vertebrae, and forelimb bones found near Izee, Oregon.
Zoneait had forelimbs that were not flattened into paddles, but its lower arm bone was reduced in length while the upper arm bone remained unchanged.
Zoneait belongs to the clade Metriorhynchoidea, which included marine crocodile relatives that lived until the Early Cretaceous.
Zoneait lived between 174.7 and 168.2 million years ago during the Aalenian to Bajocian stages.
Researchers suggest that the adaptation of metriorhynchoids to marine life began with changes in feeding ecology before changes in swimming locomotion occurred.
